content: No production Rust counting-quotient-filter crate found (search-based absence claim, LOW confidence). mqf 1.0.0 (2019) is FFI to a C++ Mixed Quotient Filter, single release, effectively dead. Squeakr itself is C++ (splatlab/squeakr). kmerutils uses Bloom/Cuckoo filters, not CQF. An exact CQF would be hand-rolled or FFI - both heavy and against the work-within-established-stack constraint. Recommendation: reuse rustkmer existing streaming_merge / prefix_cache_merge external-sort infrastructure for KMC-style partition-sort-count instead of adding a filter crate.
